agents.name: Twister
agents.description: Deploys an EMP bomb via drone. Pulses Slow enemies before the final detonation Jams and damages them.
agents.story: A skirmisher who reads the battlefield at a sprint. Twister leans on speed, momentum, and small autonomous weapons to keep the enemy at bay. The Lights Out Ultimate launches a drone-delivered EMP that pulses to slow enemies before detonating to jam and damage them. Daredevil lets him reload faster while boosting, charge Boost Energy off drifting, and take less fall damage.
